title: L9 agent memory write (l9.agent_memory_write.v1)
description: The ARGUMENTS of one model-authored durable memory write: MCP tool mcp__l9-graphite-memory__memory_write_agent, or mcp__l9-graphite-memory__memory_write_governed when task_signature is present. One atomic fact, one line, a canonical agent-lane class, an agent:<id> tag plus a topic tag, and an idempotency key so the same fact is one record. Build with `python -m ops.memory.agent_write build`; check with `python -m ops.memory.agent_write validate`. Enforced by ops/memory/agent_write.py, which this schema mirrors (tests/ops/memory/test_agent_write_schema.py). The agent keeps this contract itself: no hook, matcher or receipt stands in front of the tool (CANONICAL_LAW §8.6); MemoryService still decides grants and admission. Contract: ops/memory/AGENT_WRITE_CONTRACT.md.

namespace.description: The repository namespace from `python -m ops.memory.cli resolve` (write hint). Never main, master, default, test or the shared l9-workspace.

content.description: One atomic fact, one line, 12-600 characters. No SESSION:/WORK:-style preamble, no prose summary, never a credential.

memory_class.description: Canonical agent-lane class. Legacy words are mapped by the builder (lesson->insight, note->observation, rule->decision) and never appear in the payload, because memory_write_governed has no alias table. procedural, preference, identity and meta are not agent-lane facts.

tags.description: Exactly one agent:<id> tag naming the DERIVED identity of the writing process (cursor, claude-code-desktop, claude-code-mobile, …; never the retired agent:claude-code — ops/memory/agent_identity.py) plus at least one lowercase topic tag.

idempotency_key.description: Default agent:<namespace>:<sha256(class, normalized content)[:16]>: the same fact written twice is one record.

source_id.description: Evidence: a PR, commit, ADR or file path.

dry_run.description: A self-check: the verdict without a commit.

examples.content: Stop hooks gate on usable_receipt, not fresh_receipt, so degraded sessions still close
